subject.title: fix(plugins): bound hosted catalog feed reads on non-streaming responses

question: Should hosted catalog refresh fail closed when a fetch implementation returns a streamless response body?
rationale: The patch is a narrow memory-safety hardening, but it intentionally trades hosted feed availability for safety in environments where `Response.body` is unavailable.

options.title: Accept fail-closed fallback
options.body: Land the patch once checks pass, accepting that streamless hosted feed responses use snapshot or bundled fallback instead of hosted data.

options.title: Require bounded streamless support
options.body: Hold the PR until a safe design supports streamless bodies without trusting `Content-Length` or allocating the full untrusted response.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed fallback
recommendation.body: Land the patch once checks pass, accepting that streamless hosted feed responses use snapshot or bundled fallback instead of hosted data.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the hosted feed loader and fallback contract most directly affected by this tradeoff.
